STEP 6 - Energy: Cheese pizza is about 270 kcal/100 g. 53 g × 2.7 ≈ 143 kcal.

STEP 7 - Sanity check: One visible slice of about 50–55 g is plausible. A typical full slice from a large pizza weighs more, but only the visible portion counts here, so the estimate stays at about 53 g. The total is about 53 g and about 143 kcal.
